title: General Investigation Review
description: Baseline review applicable to any case regardless of which risk factors triggered it.

steps.title: Review the risk assessment and evidence
steps.guidance: Read the current risk score, level, evidence strength and every contributing factor with its evidence before acting.
steps.evidence_hint: Risk card and factor evidence panels

steps.title: Review project fundamentals
steps.guidance: Confirm the basic record: sanction, costs, timeline, agency, vendor, location. Note anything inconsistent with the risk evidence.

steps.title: Work applicable factor playbooks
steps.guidance: For each significant risk factor, complete the matching specialized playbook steps.

steps.title: Close with an explicit outcome
steps.guidance: Record a neutral outcome (verified issue / no issue found / data corrected / escalated / inconclusive) with written reasons. The decision is yours — AI signals are decision support only.
